🏓 PingPongRally

A single-player ping pong challenge: rally the ball back and forth with an AI opponent. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Move your paddle left and right to return the ball.
  2. The AI returns your shots — plan your placements.
  3. Rally length determines your score.
  4. The AI gets better as your rally extends, returning harder shots.
  5. Vary your shots to keep the AI guessing — placement beats power.
